why_this_part: L57b / ADR-101: the two limiter diodes per channel at the input of block A (LSK489 gate, ~1 Mohm, ~68 pF). At rest each has ~5 V reverse across it, so reverse leakage (offset into the ~1 Mohm and a non-linear leak) and a voltage-dependent junction capacitance are what matter. BAV199 is the low-leakage series double diode (typ 3 pA at 75 V, 25 C, datasheet p. 3); the BAV99 has no typical leakage figure and 30 nA max at 25 V, 25 C (BAV199: 5 nA max at 75 V, 25 C).
